constant_items._starter__2_why: `veg kathi roll`, not `veg kati roll`. The pin was being STAMPED as text rather than narrowing the cell — a pin that names no dish has nothing to narrow to, and kati/kathi is one word spelled two ways. Booking's own menu import is where `veg_kathi_roll` came from, so the dish is in this client's own pool; `mix_veg_kathi_roll` is a different dish and the pin does not say mix. Stamped, the roll counted toward no colour, no cuisine and no no-repeat check.
